segments.name: Home healthcare
products: ostomy, wound care (including negative pressure wound therapy), urology, inconti
segments.description: Provides home medical equipment, disposable medical supplies and related clinical and administrative support services to patients with chronic, complex and acute conditions.
segments.evidence: We are one of the industry's highest-quality providers of home healthcare equipment, medical supplies and related services, while maintaining a commitment to being a low-cost operator.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by managed care plans, Medicare, Medicaid, private insurers, home health agencies and patients under fee-for-service and capitation arrangements for equipment, supplies and services rented and sold to patients.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenues are generated through fee-for-service and capitation arrangements with large government and commercial payors (Payors) for equipment, supplies, services and other items rented and sold to patients.

changes.text: In 2025, the company sold its Products & Healthcare Services business, which is no longer reported in continuing operations.
changes.evidence: On December 31, 2025, we completed the sale of the P&HS business pursuant to the Purchase Agreement.

changes.text: In 2025, the company changed its name from Owens & Minor, Inc. to Accendra Health, Inc.
changes.evidence: Accendra Health, Inc. (f/k/a Owens & Minor, Inc.) and subsidiaries (Accendra Health, we, us, our or the Company) is a leading nationwide provider of products, technology, and services that supports health beyond the hospital for millions of people each year.
